description: Typed schema for the IndraMQTT broker file configuration. Generated from the single source of truth in broker-config; do not edit by hand.

allow_anonymous.description: Whether anonymous connections are accepted while no users are configured.

enabled.description: Whether authentication checks apply to client connects.

password_hash.description: Password hashing algorithm for stored credentials.

bind.description: Cluster SWIM UDP bind address for peer discovery and membership.

enabled.description: Whether multi-node distributed clustering is enabled.

gossip_bind.description: Gossip membership bind address for peer discovery.

quic_bind.description: Multiplexed data plane bind address for inter-broker message routing.

seed_nodes.description: Seed node addresses to join an existing cluster.

coap_bind.description: CoAP gateway UDP listen address. Empty disables the gateway.

allowed_realms.description: Trusted client realms. Empty allows any realm that verifies.

clock_skew_secs.description: Clock-skew allowance in seconds for ticket validity and authenticator timestamps.

keytab_path.description: Keytab file for Kerberos authentication. Empty disables Kerberos.

realm.description: Expected service realm. Empty disables the realm check on the service name.

role_map.description: Comma-separated principal=role mappings for verified client principals.

service_principal.description: Service principal name held in the keytab.

base_dn.description: Base DN under which directory users are searched.

bind_dn.description: Service account DN used for the initial bind plus search.

bind_password.description: Service account password for the initial bind.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to a PEM CA certificate for private directories.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Timeout covering TCP connect plus TLS handshake.

read_timeout_ms.description: Timeout covering each directory bind/search round-trip.

required_group.description: Required group DN: the entry must list this DN to connect.

server_url.description: Directory server URL for LDAP authentication. Empty disables LDAP.

user_filter.description: User search filter with a {username} placeholder, escaped per RFC 4515.

expiry_warn_days.description: Days before expiry that the approaching-expiry alarm and log warning start.

install_file.description: Install the licence token read from this path and exit.

license_file.description: Path to the enterprise cryptographic license key file.

license_key.description: Enterprise commercial license key for multi-node clustering.

request_out.description: Write the installation licence request to this path and exit.

trusted_keys_path.description: Trusted licence-signing keys: a JSON file or directory of JSON files.

bind.description: Bind address for the management REST API. Empty disables the API.

enabled.description: Whether the management REST API and dashboard serve requests.

backlog.description: Listener accept backlog for the plaintext MQTT listener.

bind.description: Bind address for the plaintext MQTT listener.

enabled.description: Whether the plaintext MQTT listener accepts connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections on the plaintext MQTT listener.

bind.description: Bind address for the secure TLS MQTT listener.

cert_file.description: Path to the PEM server certificate for the TLS listener.

enabled.description: Whether the secure TLS MQTT listener accepts connections.

key_file.description: Path to the PEM private key for the TLS listener.

bind.description: Bind address for the MQTT-over-WebSocket listener.

enabled.description: Whether the MQTT-over-WebSocket listener accepts connections.

bind.description: Bind address for the secure WebSocket listener.

cert_file.description: Path to the PEM server certificate for the secure WebSocket listener.

enabled.description: Whether the secure WebSocket listener accepts connections.

key_file.description: Path to the PEM private key for the secure WebSocket listener.

path.description: HTTP path serving secure WebSocket traffic.

level.description: Logging verbosity for the kernel (trace, debug, info, warn, error).

brokerlink_bind.description: BrokerLink IPC listen address for edge clients (TCP loopback).

data_dir.description: Directory holding kernel persistent state (state.toml). Created on boot when missing.

id.description: Unique identifier for this broker node within the cluster.

stream_dir.description: Durable stream journal directory. Empty disables journaling.

burst_multiplier.description: Token bucket burst multiplier (allows bursts up to burst times rate).

default_max_connections.description: Default max connections per authenticated username (0 = unlimited).

default_max_publish_rate.description: Default token-bucket publish rate limit in messages per second (0 = unlimited).

backpressure_policy.description: Default memory backpressure policy when the rule buffer is full.

window_channel_depth.description: Ingress ring buffer channel depth for stateful window worker tasks.

max_inflight_messages.description: Maximum inflight unacknowledged QoS 1 and QoS 2 messages.

max_offline_queue.description: Maximum queued offline messages per session.

max_qos0_backlog.description: Per-subscriber QoS 0 egress backlog bound; past it the oldest queued QoS 0 frame drops.

max_session_expiry_secs.description: Max session expiry interval in seconds.

title: IndraMQTT broker configuration
